body_html:
@wiobyrne This is all going through @withknown. I haven't been posting natively to Twitter for some time. Syndication IMO works better using @withknown than WordPress IMO. Only reason I want to experiment with WordPress #indieweb is to get more post-kinds and build feeds for different post-kinds.

I am still running Derybshire. I ned to update @withknown from the GitHub repo.
